arguments.query: SELECT s.shipment_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(delivered_ts), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), SUM(delivered_ts=''), MIN(length(shipped_ts)), MAX(length(shipped_ts)), MIN(length(delivered_ts)), MAX(length(delivered_ts)) FROM shipments

SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)), MIN(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.order_ts >= '2024-12-31 16:00:00' AND o.order_ts < '2025-12-31 16:00:00'
